ItemID: unavailable; Title: Greatest Hits by Pat Benatar; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Rock hits do not fit my current interest in relaxing classical music and melodic vocal performances.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Blown Away; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It could suit the country side of my listening, but I would choose a gentler vocal album this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A vocal duet album appeals to my interest in polished singing and theatrical melodies from Stages and A Musical Affair.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: BRINGING BACK THE SUNSHINE; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not drawn strongly enough to this country selection when I want something closer to my recent classical listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Loaded: The Best Of Blake Shelton; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My occasional country listening does not give me a strong reason to choose this collection right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Christmas vocal music fits my history, but I am not seeking another seasonal album this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Forte; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its classical crossover vocals fit my interest in Amor & Pasion, Under One Sky, and Lead With Your Heart particularly well.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Greatest Hits Definitive All Time; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist or more information, I cannot tell whether this collection matches my taste closely enough to choose it.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: In The Lonely Hour; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Contemporary pop feels less suited to my current mood than orchestral music or classical crossover singing.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Crazy Love; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: If this is the familiar vocal standards album, it could suit my taste, but Forte is a clearer match today.
